CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 9, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Community Development Conference Room
  of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Corona, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative;  Steve Kuchenski,
  Secretary/City Architect

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – May 26, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the May 26, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the May 26, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-170
  • 46 South Second Street
  • Applicant: Brandon Pyle
  • Request: This is an application for the development of a new 61,982
  SF 36-unit multifamily residential project, which includes a central
  courtyard, shared resident amenity spaces, one level of subterranean
  parking, one level of podium parking, and associated site
  improvements. This is a joint venture project with the City of Alhambra
  known as “Mariposa.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-23-118
  • 146 South Palm Avenue
  • Applicant: Kasey Clark and Jennifer Colicchio
  • Request: This is an application for a new Master Sign Program for a
  commercial center located within the block bounded by South Palm
  Avenue, South Raymond Avenue, and Pepper Street. The
  commercial center consists of three (3) separate tenant spaces
  occupied by Raising Cane’s, Panda Express, and Starbucks, each
  operating under an individual street address while sharing common
  parking and circulation areas.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the freestanding pole signs for Starbucks/Panda
  Express to include a single line of text that says “Drive Thru.”
  2. Revise Page 37 to incorporate the correct references for
  Monument Signs M1 and M2, ensuring consistency with the
  monument sign designations identified on Page 4.
  3. Revise the plans to clearly identify Cane’s Sign 04 as a flush-
  mounted, front-lit sign and not a halo-illuminated sign.
  4. Revise the plans to clearly specify the proposed colors and
  finishes for all components of Cane’s Signs 07 and 08,
  including, but not limited to, the galvanized steel supports and
  the sign cabinet/boxed case.
  5. Provide the complete sign details for Starbucks Sign O, as
  identified in the elevation drawing on Page 38.
  6. Revise Page 38 to remove the references to the maximum
  wall signage calculation for the south elevation that is not
  applicable to the proposed canopy sign.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the freestanding pole signs for Starbucks/Panda
  Express to reduce the overall size and scale of the single-line
  “Drive Thru” text displayed on both sides of each sign. The
  applicant shall submit the revised sign design to City Staff for
  review and approval.

  4
